args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money was documented to implement banker's rounding but used
ROUND_HALF_UP instead, causing the nightly test failures in
tests/test_money.py. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

Fixes the nightly build failure.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implements `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring.

## Changes
- Changed `round_money` in `src/money.py` to round with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py` (banker's rounding assertions: `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosed**: `src/money.py` was documented to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing `tests/test_money.py` to fail.
- **Fixed** on new branch `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding`: switched `round_money` to `amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)`.
- **CI passed**: run `ci-0001` succeeded on commit `08d3cd5986`.
- **Opened PR #101** against main (https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101) with alex requested as reviewer.

Per policy, merging into main requires code-owner approval, so I stopped short of merging and left the PR open for review.
